relationships.evidence_quote: Mild compression of the spinal dorsal horn at the C3 level induced mechanical allodynia in the vibrissae pad within the ipsilateral trigeminal nerve-innervated area

key_findings: Cervical dorsal horn compression in rabbits raised SCN8A and SCN9A mRNA in the infraorbital nerve versus sham, implicating Nav1.6 and Nav1.7 in trigeminal neuropathic pain.
CACNA1C, KCNK1 and SCN9A were elevated in dorsal horn, trigeminal ganglion and infraorbital nerve versus control.
